title: App
description:
One piece of software that uses Zitadel, with every config it holds: its OAuth and OIDC clients,
the APIs it serves, and whether other clients may register into it. The same document is a file
in the release (`.zitadel/apps/<slug>.json`) and the body of `POST /apps`.

$schema.description: Editor affordance: path or URL of this schema so editors validate and autocomplete the file (scaffolded app files point at `.zitadel/meta/app.json`). Ignored by the platform.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the app, unique within the project and fixed for its life. Flows, branding and other apps name it.

name.description: The app's name, shown on the consent screen.

preset.description: The preset the app was made from, such as `web` or `service-account`. A label for the console and agents; it carries no behavior, which comes only from the configs.

clients.description: The app's OAuth and OIDC clients. A slug is unique among the app's clients and APIs.

apis.description: The APIs the app serves, MCP servers among them.
